description: This file defines a singleton ApiClient object that configures and provides a Retrofit instance for network communication, including setup of interceptors for authorization and logging, and also includes an AuthInterceptor class that adds an authorization header if a token is available.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Provides a singleton Retrofit instance with methods to initialize and create service implementations.

classes.name: AuthInterceptor
classes.description: An OkHttp interceptor that adds an Authorization header with the access token if available.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Configures and initializes the Retrofit singleton with logging and authorization interceptors.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Produces a Retrofit API service implementation of the specified class.

methods.name: intercept
methods.description: Adds authorization header to HTTP requests if an access token is available.
